The '''giant walking fish''' was a large, monstrous [[Fish/Legends|fish]]. It was shaped like a [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]], covered in [[brown]] scales impervious to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, and had fins, underdeveloped foreclaws, and spiny [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Giant walking fish liked to eat [[glowworm]]s.

[[Hobbrock]] was a domesticated walking fish that lived in boiling, [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfurous]] [[Water/Legends|water]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].
